previous_assumption: tsx's watch mode flag order is `tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env watch src/index.ts` (Node-style flags first, then the watch subcommand, then the entry file) — the same order that works for the plain (non-watch) migrate script.
correction: tsx's own usage is `tsx <command> [flags...] [script]` — the `watch` subcommand must come immediately after `tsx`, before any flags, or tsx never recognizes it as its watch subcommand and instead treats the literal word 'watch' as the entry script path, failing with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND ("Cannot find module '.../apps/api/watch'"). This bug was never caught earlier because Stage 5 verification only exercised the built production path (`pnpm build && pnpm start`), never `pnpm dev`/`tsx watch` itself. Fixed to `tsx watch --env-file-if-exists=.env src/index.ts`.
